Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and swapped the directors’ birth years, claiming Lambert Hillyer was born in 1894 and David Butler in 1893, despite the sources showing Hillyer (1893) and Butler (1894). This inversion led to an incorrect comparison and the wrong final answer (choosing The Whistle instead of The Daughter of Rosie O'Grady).
